turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, Hale. Who decided, and on what basis?
"Get this over with." Okay. I asked you who decided and on what basis, so answer that.
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.

My child never lies, and "everyone knows it" isn't evidence, Hale. I'm writing down that you called my son a cheater with nothing in front of you. Show me a document, or I'm going to the principal's office when I leave this room.
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.

This isn't about my job, it's about your procedure, and section 4.2 says you call the parent before a mark goes in. Nobody called me. Withdraw the zero, or tell me now that you won't, so I know which office I'm walking to.
Are you going to keep wasting my time?
You asked for this meeting, Hale. I've asked three times for something on paper, and you've given me nothing but your opinion of my son. One more chance: is there a document, or do I go upstairs?
